name: Nanjing Sunlord Electronics Corporation Ltd.
summary: Nanjing Sunlord Electronics Corporation Ltd. distributes electronic components in China. The company operates in automotive electronics, industrial control, network communication, and consumer electronics. It provides capacitor, resistance, inductance, connector, crystal / clock, radio frequency communication, protective device, network and high frequency transformer, IX DC contactor, switch, relay, Bluetooth, storage, signal chain, audio power amplifier, sensor, micro control unit, discrete device, central processing unit, power supply management, isolator, integrated circuit, electric motor, interface, and wireless module. The company was founded in 1999 and is based in Nanjing, China.
